display_name: 独立多视图教师学生 GPU 训练
description: 从头训练单输入独立时频学生，使用同一源记录三个模拟视图的 DURA 平均输出作为训练教师。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 GPU1 FP32 TF32off deterministic source training; CPU ground

data.representation: Paired source received/clean IQ and same-record mean of three fixed DURA source outputs
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 32768 source fit IDs randomly sampled without replacement after excluding RX4/6/8 day3 and the 672 fixed source pilot IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: 672 fixed previously explored source L_s/U_s IQ, not independent of DURA

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: DirectSpectralStudent initialized from scratch; frozen original DURA source teacher
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Fixed DURA source-only provenance, exact ordered 32768 source fit IDs and matched clean IQ across three source views
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Source-only paired IQ and frozen DURA; no F/TX/V/target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 20; no target or pilot score selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU1 only; at least 4096 MiB free and fewer than three total compute apps; queue waits without GPU
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner only for source contract/role mismatch, nonfinite computation, incorrect checkpoint, target leakage or unrecoverable technical failure. Preserve all artifacts.

rows.method: From-scratch direct spectral student distilled from same-record three-view source DURA mean
rows.purpose: Train an independent single-IQ recovery student with a source-only multiview teacher
rows.seed_notes: Model initialization 2026110612, source IDs 2026110611, order 2026110613, evaluation 2026092701
rows.budget_ref: 117062 student parameters, 32768 source IDs x three views x 20 epochs batch32; fixed source context. Matched single-view teacher baseline 20261106-phase1-direct-spectral-wide-distill-source-s2026092701-r01

notes: Source teacher for each physical record averages frozen DURA outputs from three source simulations, clean alignment checked before training.
Objective is clean IQ NMSE + 0.5 teacher IQ NMSE, same weights, fit IDs, architecture and epoch budget as matched single-view-teacher source baseline.
One input received IQ only at inference; no DURA, second view, teacher, clean, F or TX labels required by the recovery model.
Source views need not be statistically independent. Source multi-view averaging is not a deployable target evaluation.
No F/TX/V/target during recovery training; fixed final epoch then mandatory 168000 x seven Phase1 ground views and truth-last.
GPU1 queue waits when >=3 total compute apps or less than 4096 MiB free; preserve other jobs.
